description: This file defines the ModTracker class, a context manager for tracking nn.Module hierarchy during forward and backward passes in PyTorch, including hook registration and callback management.

classes.name: ModTracker
classes.description: A context manager class that tracks the hierarchy of nn.Modules during execution, providing hooks and callback management for forward and backward passes.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the ModTracker, setting up internal state for tracking modules and hooks.

methods.name: _maybe_set_engine_callback
methods.description: Queues callbacks in the autograd engine to reset the module hierarchy tracking after backward.

methods.name: is_bw
methods.description: Property indicating if the current execution is during the backward pass.

methods.name: get_known_fqn
methods.description: Returns the fully qualified name of a module if known.

methods.name: register_user_hooks
methods.description: Registers user-defined hooks for forward and backward passes.

methods.name: _get_mod_name
methods.description: Recursively determines the module's name and caches it.

methods.name: _get_append_fn
methods.description: Creates a function to handle module entry during backward pass, updating hierarchy and calling hooks.

methods.name: _get_pop_fn
methods.description: Creates a function to handle module exit during backward pass, updating hierarchy and calling hooks.

methods.name: _fw_pre_hook
methods.description: Hook called before a module's forward pass, registers hooks and manages hierarchy.

methods.name: _fw_post_hook
methods.description: Hook called after a module's forward pass, manages hierarchy and registers gradient hooks.

methods.name: __enter__
methods.description: Enables the module forward hooks and returns self for context management.

methods.name: __exit__
methods.description: Removes the registered hooks to clean up.
